name: UWF Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands twice in early 1999 and was left unsettled after a Blackout upset, pending the promotion's own Battle for the Belt tournament.

name: UWF Arena Championship
epitaph: Held by the undefeated Powerhouse through the start of 1999, survived even after his first non-title loss.

name: UWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Death's Claw entering 1999, the promotion's all-time top-ranked tag team.

name: UWF Superheavyweight Championship
epitaph: Vacated in February 1999 after the promotion severed ties with a champion's handler over his conduct toward its president.

name: UWF Lightweight Championship
epitaph: Held by The Scissor, of the stable Zombies Unlimited, through early 1999.

name: UWF Gang Warfare Championship
epitaph: A stable-vs-stable title first won by Fates Warning in 1998; the promotion's own records name more than one concurrent champion in early 1999, not reconciled here.
